info.name: FastShip - Delhivery B2C (Express)
info.description: Focused checks for the admin-only FastShip Delhivery B2C proxy. The collection signs in to FastShip before calling Delhivery B2C serviceability APIs.

exec: pm.test('FastShip admin token is returned', function () { pm.expect(token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Checks one consignee pincode with Delhivery B2C GET /c/api/pin-codes/json/?filter_codes={pincode}. Empty delivery_codes means NSZ; remark Embargo means temporary NSZ; blank remark means serviceable.

exec: pm.test('B2C serviceability proxy reports success', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('serviceable flag follows Delhivery pincode remarks', function () { pm.expect(body.serviceable).to.be.a('boolean'); });
